metadata.description: ORM date/period composition: calendar Date/Datetime vs identifier text

module.name: orm_dates
module.description: Calendar year and period of a record come from Date/Datetime fields. Identifier Char fields are a different question.

rules.rule: Year, period, or “in YYYY”: filter, group and label with Date/Datetime fields. Probe Model._fields for type date or datetime. Prefer the model’s business date (date, date_end, date_deadline, date_order, invoice_date, …). Use create_date only when no business date exists. Skip write_date.
When the user names years (e.g. 2025, 2026), use those integers as literals. Never compute them as date.today().year + N or any relative offset.
Digits in name, code, display_name or a customer reference are identifiers, not a calendar year.
When the user asks to search name, code or reference text: match those Char fields with ilike (or equivalent). That is identifier lookup, not a calendar period.

pattern.name: year_from_date_field
pattern.description: Calendar year from a Date/Datetime field. Probe _fields; prefer business date over create_date.
pattern.code_snippet: year = 2026 # integer the user named fields = Model._fields date_names = [ n for n, f in fields.items() if getattr(f, 'type', None) in ('date', 'datetime') and n != 'write_date' ] preferred = ('date', 'date_end', 'date_deadline', 'date_order', 'invoice_date') name = next((n for n in preferred if n in date_names), None) if not name: name = next((n for n in date_names if n != 'create_date'), None) if not name and 'create_date' in date_names: name = 'create_date' recs = Model.search([ (name, '>=', '%s-01-01' % year), (name, '<=', '%s-12-31' % year), ]) if name else Model.browse() # label: rec[name].year if rec[name] else None

pattern.name: search_identifier_text
pattern.description: Match identifier Char fields when the user asks to search name, code or reference.
pattern.code_snippet: needle = 'TEXT' # identifier fragment the user gave name_f = 'name' if 'name' in Model._fields else 'display_name' recs = Model.search([(name_f, 'ilike', needle)])
